description: Unit test class for the Leads module in SuiteCRM, testing various methods including bean retrieval, query generation, data filling, notifications, ACL, and related records.

classes.name: LeadTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for the Leads module in SuiteCRM, containing multiple test methods to verify behavior and data integrity of Lead beans.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up environment before each test, initializing global variables and configurations.

methods.name: testLead
methods.description: Tests object instantiation and basic attribute assertions for the Lead bean.

methods.name: testget_account
methods.description: Tests the get_account method for null and preset attribute scenarios.

methods.name: testget_opportunity
methods.description: Tests the get_opportunity method for null and preset attribute scenarios.

methods.name: testget_contact
methods.description: Tests the get_contact method for null and preset attribute scenarios.

methods.name: testcreate_list_query
methods.description: Verifies the SQL query generated by create_list_query with empty and specific parameters.

methods.name: testcreate_new_list_query
methods.description: Intended to test create_new_list_query but currently marked as needing fixing.

methods.name: testSaveAndConverted_lead
methods.description: Tests saving a lead, and placeholder for testing conversion and deletion logic (skipped in current test).

methods.name: testfill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Verifies that additional list view fields are filled correctly based on name attributes.

methods.name: testfill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Verifies that additional detail view fields are filled correctly based on name attributes.

methods.name: testget_list_view_data
methods.description: Checks the data returned for list view, focusing on key fields like name, deletion status, and email link.

methods.name: testget_linked_fields
methods.description: Verifies that get_linked_fields returns the expected set of linked field names.

methods.name: testbuild_generic_where_clause
methods.description: Tests the construction of WHERE clauses with empty and sample input; currently marked as skipped.

methods.name: testset_notification_body
methods.description: Verifies that notification body template variables are correctly set based on lead attributes.

methods.name: testbean_implements
methods.description: Tests the bean_implements method for various interface flags.

methods.name: testlistviewACLHelper
methods.description: Checks the ACL helper working, expecting full access permissions.

methods.name: testconvertCustomFieldsForm
methods.description: Tests conversion of custom fields form, expecting success and presence of form modification.

methods.name: testget_unlinked_email_query
methods.description: Verifies the SQL query for fetching unlinked emails related to a lead.

methods.name: testget_old_related_calls
methods.description: Checks SQL generation for fetching old related calls.

methods.name: testGetActivitiesOptions
methods.description: Verifies the static method that provides activity options.

methods.name: testget_old_related_meetings
methods.description: Checks SQL generation for fetching old related meetings.
